\section{Public Repositories}\label{res-repos:public-repositories}

\subsection{STEPSS (GUI)}\label{res-repos:stepss-gui}

The main graphical user interface for STEPSS, built with Java (Swing/AWT) and the Ant build system.

\begin{itemize}
\tightlist
\item
  \textbf{Repository}: \href{https://github.com/SPS-L/stepss-java-ui}{github.com/SPS-L/stepss-java-ui}
\item
  \textbf{License}: Apache License 2.0
\item
  \textbf{Requirements}: 64-bit Java 11 or later to run the jar, none at all to run an installer, JDK plus Apache Ant to build
\item
  \textbf{Build}: \texttt{ant\ jar}
\item
  \textbf{Run}: \texttt{java\ -jar\ dist/stepss.jar}, or \texttt{ant\ bundle} for a native installer
\end{itemize}

\subsection{stepss-python-ui}\label{res-repos:stepss-python-ui}

Python interface to the RAMSES simulator providing scripting access to simulations, plus the \texttt{stepss.helios} module for AC power flows with the bundled Helios engine (Windows, Linux, and macOS).

\begin{itemize}
\tightlist
\item
  \textbf{Repository}: \href{https://github.com/SPS-L/stepss-python-ui}{github.com/SPS-L/stepss-python-ui}
\item
  \textbf{Install}: \texttt{pip\ install\ stepss}
\item
  \textbf{Documentation}: \hyperref[doc:py-overview]{Python API section} on this site
\item
  \textbf{Includes}: five runnable power-flow examples under \texttt{examples/helios/}
\end{itemize}

\subsection{stepss-userguide}\label{res-repos:stepss-userguide}

The original LaTeX source for the STEPSS documentation (models reference and user guide).

\begin{itemize}
\tightlist
\item
  \textbf{Repository}: \href{https://github.com/SPS-L/stepss-userguide}{github.com/SPS-L/stepss-userguide}
\item
  \textbf{Build}: \texttt{pdflatex\ stepss\_doc.tex} (run twice)
\item
  \textbf{Main file}: \texttt{stepss\_doc.tex}
\end{itemize}

\subsection{stepss-uramses}\label{res-repos:stepss-uramses}

Framework for compiling and linking custom Fortran models with RAMSES.

\begin{itemize}
\tightlist
\item
  \textbf{Repository}: \href{https://github.com/SPS-L/stepss-uramses}{github.com/SPS-L/stepss-uramses}
\item
  \textbf{Platforms}: Linux (gfortran), macOS (gfortran, Apple Silicon), Windows (MinGW gfortran or Intel Fortran)
\item
  \textbf{Build (Linux)}: \texttt{make\ -f\ build/Makefile.linux\ all}
\item
  \textbf{Build (macOS)}: \texttt{make\ -f\ build/Makefile.macos\ all}
\item
  \textbf{Build (Windows/MinGW)}: \texttt{make\ -f\ build/Makefile.windows\ all}
\item
  \textbf{Build (Windows/Intel)}: Visual Studio with \texttt{build/msvs/URAMSES.sln}
\end{itemize}

\subsection{stepss-eigenanalysis}\label{res-repos:stepss-eigenanalysis}

Reference spectra and the validation suite for RAMSES's built-in small-signal
analysis. The analysis itself runs in the engine, documented under
\hyperref[doc:eigenanalysis]{Eigenanalysis}; this repository holds the
independently captured reference data the engine is checked against, so its
tests need neither a RAMSES licence nor the engine itself.

\begin{itemize}
\tightlist
\item
  \textbf{Repository}: \href{https://github.com/SPS-L/stepss-eigenanalysis}{github.com/SPS-L/stepss-eigenanalysis}
\item
  \textbf{Requirements}: Python with numpy and pytest
\end{itemize}

\subsection{stepss-cg-studio (CODEGEN Studio)}\label{res-repos:stepss-cg-studio-codegen-studio}

Browser-based visual editor for building CODEGEN user-defined models with drag-and-drop blocks.

\begin{itemize}
\tightlist
\item
  \textbf{Repository}: \href{https://github.com/SPS-L/stepss-cg-studio}{github.com/SPS-L/stepss-cg-studio}
\item
  \textbf{Requirements}: Python 3.10 or later
\item
  \textbf{Install}: \texttt{pip\ install\ stepss-cg-studio}
\item
  \textbf{Run}: \texttt{cg-studio} \ensuremath{\rightarrow} open \texttt{http://localhost:8765}
\item
  \textbf{Documentation}: \hyperref[doc:cg-studio]{CODEGEN Studio guide} on this site
\end{itemize}

\begin{docsnote}{Note}

Test-system data repositories (Nordic, 5-bus, Kundur, GB Network, and others) are not listed here; see the \hyperref[doc:ts-index]{Test Systems} section of this site.

\end{docsnote}
